title: Reinstatement Fee Charged — Homesite Reservation Fee Calculation
content:
**Calculation clause.** The reinstatement fee charged for reinstating an expired Homesite Reservation hold is worked out in three steps, in this order, each acting on the result of the step before it.

- **First**, the reinstatement lender discount is taken off the class's reinstatement fee and the result is rounded half up to the cent.
- **Second**, the reinstatement card surcharge and the reinstatement timing surcharge are added together into one surcharge percent, that combined percent is applied once to the amount after the lender discount, and the total is rounded half up to the cent; the two surcharges do not act one after the other.
- **Third**, the reinstatement reminder method is applied to that total.

The reinstatement lender discount is nothing, the reinstatement card surcharge is nothing, the reinstatement timing surcharge is nothing, and under the reinstatement reminder method the total is charged as it stands. The reinstatement fee charged is therefore the class's reinstatement fee of the reservation's premium class, charged as it stands.

## Bases of each step

| Step | Base it acts on | Rounding |
|---|---|---|
| Lender discount | the class's reinstatement fee | half up to the cent |
| Combined surcharge | the amount after the lender discount, once, at the sum of both surcharge percents | half up to the cent |
| Reminder method | the total after the combined surcharge | as the method states |

## Worked example (hypothetical class reinstatement fee of 400.00)

The lender discount takes nothing off: 400.00. The combined surcharge adds nothing: 400.00. The reminder method charges the total as it stands: the reinstatement fee charged is 400.00.
